description: This script is a Node.js command-line utility for running specific extension tests using Vitest. It processes command-line arguments, resolves test plans, and executes test batches accordingly.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Runs a batch of Vitest tests in a child process with specified parameters.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: printNoTestsMessage
methods.description: Logs a message indicating no tests are found for the given extension plan.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution function that processes arguments, resolves test plans, and runs tests.
